content.story_tagline: More Than a Bakery. A Part of Every Celebration.
content.story_body:
We opened our first bakery in Hyderabad in 1999. More than 26 years on, one small neighbourhood shop has become a name families across the city keep coming back to. Cakes, breads, desserts, savoury snacks, café favourites, we bake all of it fresh and put the same care into every one. That much has not changed since the beginning.

Food has a way of turning up in the moments that matter. The birthday cake nobody forgets. The puff you grab on the way home. The bread on the table at breakfast. The wedding cake that ends up in every photo. We think about that when we start baking each morning, because we know we are not just filling a shelf. We are part of somebody's day.
content.mission_text: We together make celebrations more delightful by reaching millions of hearts through our wholesome food products.
content.team_subheading: It takes a lot of hands to get fresh product on the shelf every day. Here are the people who do it.
content.team_quote: "Sharing the joy of baking with you"

page.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
page.subheading: Everything Hyderabad usually asks us, in one place.
page.intro: Whether you're ordering a cake for a birthday, picking up your favourite bakery treats, or planning something special, here are answers to some of the questions customers ask us most often.
page.cta_text: Couldn't find the answer you're looking for? We're happy to help. Message us on WhatsApp and our team will assist you with your order or query.

faqs.question: Do I need to create an account to place an order?
faqs.answer:
Yes. You need to create an account on the KS Bakers website or app to place an order.
A valid phone number is mandatory for ordering. This allows us to confirm your order, contact you about delivery or pickup, and share important updates.

faqs.question: Why do I need to provide my phone number?
faqs.answer:
Your phone number helps us keep you updated throughout the ordering process. We may use it to:
• Confirm your order
• Contact you about delivery or pickup
• Clarify any order or customisation requirements
• Share important updates about your order
Please make sure you provide an active phone number that you can access after placing your order.

faqs.question: Can I order a cake for same-day delivery?
faqs.answer:
Yes. Same-day availability depends on the cake, outlet, availability, and design requirements.
Plain and semi-custom cakes may be available for same-day delivery from selected outlets. For fully custom cakes, we recommend placing your order at least 24 to 48 hours in advance so our team has enough time to prepare it properly.

faqs.question: Can I customise a cake from the KS Bakers menu?
faqs.answer:
Yes. Most cakes can be customised to some extent, including the flavour, size, message, and basic design.
If you have a specific theme or want a completely personalised cake, you can explore our Custom Cakes section or contact us directly on WhatsApp.

faqs.question: Can I add a message to my cake?
faqs.answer:
Yes. A cake message can be added to most cakes where customisation is available.
Please check your message carefully before placing the order, especially names, spellings, dates, and other personal details.

faqs.question: Can I order a completely custom-designed cake?
faqs.answer:
Yes. We accept requests for custom and personalised cakes.
Custom cakes can vary in design, size, flavour, finishing, and preparation time. For a fully customised cake, we recommend contacting our team in advance so we can understand your requirements and confirm what is possible.

faqs.question: Does KS Bakers offer home delivery?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can either collect your order from a KS Bakers outlet or choose home delivery if your location is within our serviceable area.

faqs.question: How can I check if my area is covered for delivery?
faqs.answer:
Enter your delivery address during checkout.
If your location is outside our delivery service area, you will be informed during checkout and can choose store pickup instead.

faqs.question: What happens if I am not available when my order is delivered?
faqs.answer:
Our delivery partner will try to contact you using the phone number provided with your order.
Please keep your phone reachable around the expected delivery window and make sure someone is available to receive the order. This is especially important for cakes and other fresh products.

faqs.question: Can someone else receive my order for me?
faqs.answer:
Yes. Someone else can receive your order at the delivery address.
We recommend informing the person in advance, particularly when the order contains a cake or another product that needs to be handled carefully.

faqs.question: What happens if the delivery cannot be completed because I am unavailable?
faqs.answer:
Our delivery partner will make reasonable attempts to contact you.
However, an order may not be eligible for a refund solely because delivery could not be completed due to the customer being unavailable, providing an incorrect or incomplete address, or another issue caused by the customer.

faqs.question: What payment methods does KS Bakers accept?
faqs.answer:
Depending on the options available at checkout, you can pay using:
• Credit and debit cards
• UPI
• Net banking
• Popular digital wallets
The payment options available for your order will be shown at checkout.

faqs.question: Is it safe to pay online?
faqs.answer:
Yes. Online payments are processed through a secure, encrypted third-party payment gateway.
KS Bakers does not store your card details on its own servers.

faqs.question: What should I do if my payment is successful but my order is not confirmed?
faqs.answer:
If the payment has been deducted but your order confirmation has not been received, please check your account or order history first.
If the order is still not visible, contact KS Bakers with your payment details or transaction reference and registered phone number, and our team can help check the status.

faqs.question: Can I cancel my order after placing it?
faqs.answer:
Cancellation depends on the type of product and the stage of preparation.
For standard products, cancellation may be possible within the applicable cancellation window.
For custom, personalised, or made-to-order cakes, cancellation is not possible once preparation has started.
If you need to cancel an order, please contact us as early as possible.

faqs.question: Can I cancel a custom cake after preparation has started?
faqs.answer:
No. Once preparation of a custom or made-to-order cake has started, the order cannot be cancelled and the amount paid will not be refundable.
Custom cakes are prepared specifically for each customer and may involve ingredients, materials, designs, and preparation work that have already been committed to the order.

faqs.question: Can I cancel a custom cake on the day of delivery?
faqs.answer:
Cancellation may not be possible, particularly if preparation has already started.
We recommend requesting cancellation at least 24 hours before the scheduled delivery or pickup time.
However, the key factor is whether preparation has already begun. Once preparation has started, a custom cake cannot be cancelled or refunded.

faqs.question: What if I need to change my custom cake order?
faqs.answer:
Please contact us as early as possible.
We will review requests based on the type of change and the stage of preparation. Once preparation has started, some changes may no longer be possible.

faqs.question: Will I get a refund if my cancellation is approved?
faqs.answer:
If your cancellation is approved and the order is eligible for a refund, the refund will generally be made to the original payment method used for the order, unless otherwise agreed.
The applicable cancellation or processing charges, if any, may be deducted from the refund.

faqs.question: What if my cake arrives damaged?
faqs.answer:
Please contact us within a reasonable time after delivery or pickup and share photographs of the cake and the issue, wherever possible.
After reviewing the concern, KS Bakers may provide an appropriate resolution, which may include a replacement, refund, or store credit, depending on the circumstances.

faqs.question: What if I receive the wrong cake?
faqs.answer:
Please contact us as soon as possible after receiving your order.
Share your Order ID and photographs of the product, where possible. Our team will review the issue and work towards an appropriate resolution.

faqs.question: What if my order is significantly different from what I ordered?
faqs.answer:
If your order is significantly different from the product you ordered, please contact us within a reasonable time of delivery or pickup.
Please provide your Order ID and photographs where possible so our team can review the concern.

faqs.question: How far in advance should I order a custom cake?
faqs.answer:
For fully custom cakes, we recommend ordering at least 24 to 48 hours in advance.
More detailed or complex designs may require additional preparation time. Availability also depends on the outlet and the requirements of your cake.

faqs.question: Can I choose the flavour and size of my cake?
faqs.answer:
Most cakes allow customisation of flavour and size, depending on the product and availability.
Available options will be shown while placing or customising your order.

faqs.question: Can I request a specific cake design?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can request a custom design.
The final design will depend on the requirements, preparation time, ingredients, materials, and feasibility. For a fully bespoke design, please contact our custom cake team in advance.

faqs.question: Does KS Bakers offer eggless cakes?
faqs.answer:
Yes. Most of our cakes are available in an eggless version.
Where an eggless option is available, you can select it while customising your cake.

faqs.question: Do KS Bakers products contain nuts, dairy, egg, or gluten?
faqs.answer:
Our kitchens handle common allergens, including nuts, dairy, egg, and gluten.
If you have a serious food allergy, please check with your nearest KS Bakers outlet before placing your order.

faqs.question: Can I order a cake based on specific dietary requirements?
faqs.answer:
Availability depends on the cake and the specific dietary requirement.
If you have an allergy or dietary restriction, we recommend contacting the nearest KS Bakers outlet before ordering so our team can guide you on the available options.

faqs.question: Does KS Bakers accept bulk or corporate orders?
faqs.answer:
Yes. We accept bulk orders for office celebrations, corporate gifting, events, and other occasions.
For bulk requirements and pricing, you can contact us on WhatsApp or explore our Gifting section.

faqs.question: Can I place a large order in advance?
faqs.answer:
Yes. For larger orders, we recommend contacting our team in advance.
This gives us time to understand your quantity, product requirements, customisation, delivery or pickup requirements, and preferred date.

faqs.question: Does KS Bakers offer corporate gifting?
faqs.answer:
Yes. KS Bakers can cater to corporate gifting and event requirements.
For larger gifting requirements, please contact our team through WhatsApp or our Gifting section to discuss your requirements.

faqs.question: How can I check the status of my order?
faqs.answer:
You can check your order through your KS Bakers account.
Your registered phone number may also be used to contact you regarding important order updates.

faqs.question: What should I do if I entered the wrong delivery address?
faqs.answer:
Please contact KS Bakers as soon as possible.
If the order has not yet been dispatched or prepared for delivery, our team will check whether the address can be updated.
For orders that have already been prepared or dispatched, changes may not be possible.

faqs.question: What should I do if I have a problem with my order?
faqs.answer:
If there is an issue with your order, please contact us as soon as possible with your Order ID and registered phone number.
If the issue concerns the product itself, photographs can also help our team understand and resolve the concern faster.
